intro: Government, telecommunications, civil society, and private-sector organizations feature among the targets covered in this surveillance tag, which collects eight ZCyberNews articles published between 2026-04-12 and 2026-10-15. Reporting spans the United states, European union, Iran, Israel, and Mexico. NSO Group appears as the top threat actor across the coverage. CVE-2026-22898, rated CVSS 8.8, is the most frequently cited vulnerability. The severity mix comprises one critical, one high, two medium, and three informational items, reflecting a range of risk levels across the archived reporting.
